desc: Derive cost formula and verify against both examples by hand (verified: 17 and 12 reproduced; key identity: work in reversed array so cost = sum of suffix-max deficits, making front-removal clean)
Design sliding-window invariant: cost monotonic in both directions, two pointers give O(n) amortized
Design incremental cost maintenance: monotonic deque of (value, count) groups; append pops ≤ x; left contraction subtracts (front_value - a[left]) and decrements/pops front group
Implement the full solution in the given starter code, summing (right - left + 1) over all right positions in reversed coordinates
Test on provided examples plus edge cases: n=1, strictly increasing array (answer n(n+1)/2), strictly decreasing array, k=1, and random arrays validated against an O(n^2) brute force
